messages.body: Foundation is about clear basics. Understand each idea once, properly.
A journal entry made calmly is a journal entry made right.
Read slowly, solve steadily. The basics reward patience.
Foundation papers reward practice. Solve ten problems before you stop.
Make the basics automatic now and the later levels feel lighter.
Time yourself on today's questions. Speed comes from repetition.
You have started the CA journey. Every Foundation chapter is a real step.
Finished a Foundation chapter today? That is progress worth noting.
The first level is the base of everything after it. Well done for building it.
